text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened while I was keeping Mejiro Bright company as she sunbathed under the chilly sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. There is something
I have not understood for the longest time.
choice_data_list: Something you haven't understood for a reeeally long time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees.
Whenever I speak with Lady Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, it is said that by intertwining their tails,
they convey their affection for one another~”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...Love is something spoken on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Bright's Friend
text_block_list.text:
""W-W-Wait, Bright-chan!?
A tail hug on Ramonu-san!?
That's gone way past amazing and straight into terrifying...!""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Howa~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's pretty much how it went~
Even when I was a kid...”

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ramonu, Lady Ramonu~.
What kind of book are you reading~?
May I stay by your side~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Servant
text_block_list.text:
""! B-Bright-sama...!?
Ramonu-sama is concentrating on her book.
You shouldn't disturb her...!""

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: "Howawa~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm with Lady Ramonu, for some reason
people are always startled or try to stop us~
It's been like that ever since we were little kids~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why I haven't understood it for the loooongest time.
Why could that be~?"
choice_data_list: You've been struggling with this for quite a long time, huh...
You've been struggling with this for quite a long time, haven't you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I feel like the answer to her question is pretty clear.
What everyone is probably thinking is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is terrified.
Of having their very self melted away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Ramonu~!
Good day. Are you out for a stroll~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear~... What a pity.
I could have joined you if it were just a walk~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Until next time, then.
Let's make a pinky promise~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's overwhelming ability and aura.
Even as an adult, I find myself involuntarily intimidated by it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Mejiro Bright treats her just as she always does.
Naturally, following the whims of her own heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~. Pinky promise with Ramonu-sama~♪
A promise~ to go for a stroll~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
? To Ramonu-sama~?
No, I certainly shall not~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Not getting nervous against Mejiro Ramonu." To someone intimidated by her, that alone looks incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Aww, I see.
So that's what was going on~
choice_data_list: On the other hand, how come you aren't nervous?
On the other hand, how come you aren't nervous?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, that is a simple matter~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because to me,
Ramonu-sama is a truly, ve~ry kind person~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...When my 'tail hug' was turned down,
we raced together afterwards~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu personally taught me
how to express love
through racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Always with utter seriousness~.
Besides, even back in our childhood...

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind, as long as you stay quiet."

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: ""! Yes-siree, I promise~!♪""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Kindness is not something merely given;
it is something to be received."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah... At long last, I truly understand from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone else must have simply overlooked it.
Ramonu-sama's kindness, that is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu's kindness is just a tiny bit easier
to make her drop than anyone else's, after all~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So overwhelming
that one cannot take it in without standing by her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was indeed so intimidated and tense
that I might have overlooked that "kindness."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it feels like a bit of a waste~.
For Lady Ramonu's kindness to simply be lost like this.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. Is there anything
I might be able to help with~?
choice_data_list: Shall we show them how much more we can eat together?
Shall we show them how much more we can train together?
Shall we show them how much more we can play together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ramonu, did you know?
Carrots actually have lo~ng leaves attached to them~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And I hear it's edible, too~
If the opportunity arises, I would love to share a meal with you~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Those two have been eating together a lot lately, haven't they~?
I'm surprised Ramonu-san doesn't mind it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because Bright-chan is like a little sister to you?
You have a bit of a big sister side too, huh.
...My impression of you might have changed a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Is that all?
Is that the depth of your love?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu.
Not quite yet~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those two are running together again.
...I'm kinda jealous, maybe~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey... If I get the chance,
would it be okay if I... tried talking to them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~, what do you think?
I drew the three of us—myself, you, and Ramonu-sama—standing side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my.
Aren't we greedy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're drawing together again~
They get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I thought Ramonu-san hated other people...
Is that really not the case, I wonder?
